⛔ Sanctions of The Commonwealth

Imposed by us:
• No. 3 on Vantor Federation: trade embargo, arms embargo, travel ban - for aggression
  in force for 2d 2h
  imposed by the President, Kaveh (B3C4D5F)

Imposed on us:
• No. 4 by Vantor Federation: financial sanctions - for retaliation
  ⏳ binds in 40m

A sanction binds both ways: a trade embargo stops the market, the auction house and company sales between the two countries' people; an arms embargo, arms sales; a technology ban, licenses; a travel ban, journeys between their cities; financial sanctions, card payments.

  [✖️ Lift No. 3 on Vantor Federation] → diplomacy:lift:3
